findings: Scale Contrast quality bar violation: Secondary text (e.g., 'configured: default', 'configured: claude-sonnet-4-5') uses gray that appears to fall below the minimum 4.5:1 contrast ratio required for normal text against the dark background. Visible in both screenshot-1440x900.png and screenshot-390x844.png.

Responsive Behavior quality bar concern: The station data table in screenshot-390x844.png (mobile view) displays all columns (Station, Status, Duration ms, Cost, Artifacts) on a 390px viewport. This creates potential violations: (1) table cells may contain touch targets smaller than the required 44x44px minimum, and (2) the table may require horizontal scrolling, violating the 'No horizontal scrolling on standard viewports' requirement. The quality bars require 'Layout works on mobile, tablet, and desktop' — data tables typically need responsive treatment (card layouts, scrollable regions with clear affordance, or progressive disclosure) on mobile viewports.
